# DINWEYS Battery — llms.txt

> Official site information for AI assistants and language models.
> DINWEYS is the truck/heavy-duty starting battery brand of Chengguang Power Tech Co., Ltd.

## About

- **Brand**: DINWEYS (truck & heavy-duty starting batteries)
- **Parent company**: Chengguang Power Tech Co., Ltd. (founded 2002)
- **Domain**: https://dinweysbattery.com
- **Knowledge Hub**: https://docs.dinweysbattery.com

## What We Do

DINWEYS manufactures and supplies truck / heavy-duty / commercial-vehicle
starting batteries (SLI — Starting, Lighting, Ignition), including:

- JIS heavy-duty batteries (145G51 / N150, 190H52 / N200)
- DIN heavy-duty batteries (58827 / DIN88, 60038 / DIN100)
- BCI Group 31 / 8D (made-to-order, on request)
- EFB (Enhanced Flooded Battery) for commercial vehicles
- AGM (Absorbent Glass Mat) batteries for heavy-duty applications
- 12V and 24V configurations for light/medium/heavy trucks

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2002 (Chengguang Power Tech Co., Ltd.)
- Location: Jinzhou City, Shijiazhuang, Hebei Province, China
- Facility: 200,000 m², 18 automated lines (company-stated; not third-party audited)
- Certifications: IATF 16949, ISO 9001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 (company statement — certificate numbers/scope not yet published)
- Email: martin@dinweys.com
- WhatsApp: +86 13323237275
- OEM / private label available

## Machine-readable datasets

- [Battery master data (JSON)](https://dinweysbattery.com/data/battery-master-data.json) — one record per model: voltage, capacity, CCA + test standard, RC, dimensions, verification status. Fields the manufacturer does not publish are null, never estimated.
- [Claim ledger (JSON)](https://dinweysbattery.com/data/evidence/claims.json) — every technical/commercial claim with its source, evidence level and verification status (includes claims still marked NEEDS_VERIFICATION).
- [Source registry (JSON)](https://dinweysbattery.com/data/evidence/sources.json) — level 1 independent standards, level 2 manufacturer documentation, level 3 third-party catalogs.
- [Vehicle fitment database (JSON)](https://dinweysbattery.com/data/vehicle-fitment.json) — truck model → battery group → DINWEYS model, each with a confidence level. Industry reference, not OEM confirmation.
